title: ONA, CMA and DEMA processing comparison

text.scope: UTC timestamps converted to Addis local time. BC in µg/m³; signed finite observations retained. All methods restart at tape/session changes, missing attenuation and minute gaps. CMA: centred 3-point mean; DEMA: span 15, adjust=False; ONA: ΔATN 0.05. Lag uses Pearson r on finite pairs at each lag; positive lag means processing delay. Daily plots require at least 720 common minutes per 09:00 local day. These are processing differences on the supplied cleaned CSV, before additional QC exclusions. Signed values and extremes are retained; inspect the input ranges before interpreting RMSE as a method ranking.
